name: Visa-Free Entry / Short-Term Visa (Tourism, Private, Business)

requirements.blocker_text: Citizens of most Western countries (EU member states, Canada, Japan, and others) may enter and stay visa-free for up to 90 days within any 180-day period; some nationalities have a shorter 30- or 14-day allowance.

An e-Visa (for tourism, private visits, medical purposes, or business/work trips in culture, science, education, or sports) or a standard consular visa from a Ukrainian diplomatic mission is required for non-exempt nationalities.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for a Ukrainian e-Visa or a consular visa.

evidence_required.document: E-Visa application or consular visa (non-exempt nationalities only)

outcome.duration_length: up to 90 days within any 180-day period (shorter for some nationalities)

sources.title: Wikipedia -- Visa policy of Ukraine: 90/180-day visa-free regime for most Western nationalities (30- or 14-day for others), e-Visa system for tourism/private/business/medical purposes
